text:
Ravi (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — Aperture Finance listing is live on FinCloud and they converted to a Dedicated + marketplace package today. Link: https://fincloud.market/aperture-finance :tada:
Ana (AE): PO processed, invoices out. Conversion includes Dedicated throughput + PCI audit add-on. Upsell value: $120k ARR.
Hannah (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff done. Verified VPC peering and test vectors. Small item: their webhook consumer expects idempotency-token header; sending note to @Cole to add header to our test harness.
Cole (Solutions): Got it  added idempotency header support in staging and a quick curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Token: <uuid>" \
  -d '{"input":"transaction_payload"}'
```
Validated p95 latency <50ms on Dedicated pool.
marketplace-bot: Listing status: draft -> published. URL: https://fincloud.market/aperture-finance (published 10:12 UTC).
Zoe (Marketing): Awesome! Can we grab a short customer quote and a screenshot of the scoring dashboard for a FinCloud spotlight and blog? Timeline: draft by Wed.
Ravi (Partnerships): @Ana can you request a 1-2 sentence quote from their Head of Fraud? @Cole please drop the screenshot to the GH doc when you have it.
Ana (AE): Reached out — they sent this quote: "Redwood's dedicated inference cut decision latency and let us block high-risk transactions faster." Sharing with @Zoe.
Marta (Legal): Marketplace addendum and PCI DPA signed. No outstanding legal issues. Noted retention: 180 days per customer.
Hannah (Customer Success): Uploading onboarding runbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/aperture-onboard.md. Note to CS: use demo token TTL=1h for sandbox workshops.
Cole (Solutions): Screenshot and short replay clip uploaded to the marketing doc. Also added a docs note: for heavy scoring pipelines set `ROUTING.policy = "dedicated_low_latency"` and `KV_CACHE=false` for micro-batches to reduce tail latency.
marketplace-bot: Analytics (first 6h): impressions=3.7k, installs=54, trials=9.
Zoe (Marketing): Drafting the case study and spotlight card. Will tag the doc and ping for approvals.
Ravi (Partnerships): Adding Asana: "Aperture Finance FinCloud case study + spotlight" assigned to @Zoe @Hannah @Cole. Great cross-functional work — closing thread. :rocket:
